$why: Skim of the Bourbaki documents that name Grothendieck (#50, priority 3): for each, the PDF pages where he appears and a few words of context in our words. Nothing is transcribed. Read on the facsimiles of archives-bourbaki.ahp-numerique.fr by Opus 5.5 agents on 2026-10-10, unchecked by a human. Intermediate: 21 of the 36 documents skimmed; groups 5 and 6 paused.
